title: Study finds Hinge Health significantly lowers fall risk for adults aged 65+
summary: Among adults aged 65+ at risk for falls, those using Hinge Health reported 37% fewer falls.
body_markdown:
# Study finds Hinge Health significantly lowers fall risk for adults aged 65+


Hinge Health's Fall Prevention program was associated with 57% lower odds of participants reporting an emergency room visit
